entities.name: Grigori
entities.description: A young man in Stensia who bleeds his sleeping mother to pay Olivia's blood tithe.

entities.name: Grigori's mother
entities.description: A woman of Stensia who fell asleep and refused to wake after the Harvesttide Massacre.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire lady who demands a nightly blood tithe from the people of Stensia and plans to wed Edgar Markov.

entities.name: Adeline
entities.description: A cathar who has fought evil since the Church took her in at age twelve and who agrees to go with Arlinn to see Sorin.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer who burns vampires and cheers Adeline with wine.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A planeswalker and werewolf who leads the counterattacks and proposes asking Sorin Markov for help.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker with time magic who says he cannot move the moon alone.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who argues that the group must stick together and visit Sorin.

entities.name: Deidama
entities.description: A witch among the group who tends the sick and wounded.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker and the protector of Innistrad who learns that his grandfather Edgar's coffin is missing and that Olivia plans a wedding.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: Sorin's ancient vampire grandfather, who slumbers in a mausoleum and who has been stolen.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: The werewolf whose fight with Arlinn has worn on her.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: An angel whom Sorin fought the last time the group met him.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The angel Adeline hopes a trace of is left in Sorin; her eventual fall is wondered about.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Sorin's failed protege, whose short war with him ruined much of Markov manor.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: The key Olivia Voldaren stole, which the group needs to recover.

entities.name: Harvesttide Massacre
entities.description: The attack on the festival that ended with the endless night.

entities.name: Arlinn's resistance
entities.description: A group of humans, witches, deputized fiendslayers and planeswalkers who fight vampires; two hundred others shelter in the woods.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: The vampire-dominated region of Innistrad where Grigori lives.

entities.name: Karo
entities.description: A village that vampires descend on, from which a small boy ran to Arlinn's group.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: Sorin's ruined castle with its intact family archives and the mausoleum of his grandfather.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane in eternal night.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: A region where villagers only suspected werewolves nearby and where houses can be raised in a day.

events.summary: Weeks after the Harvesttide Massacre, Grigori draws blood from his sleeping mother to meet Olivia Voldaren's tithe decree.
events.quote: Grigori presses the knife to his mother's wrist.

events.summary: Olivia's decree demands one bowl of blood from every resident each night until the festivities.
events.quote: one bowl of blood from each resident, once a night until the festivities

events.summary: Bats carry away the bowls of blood and ornate black envelopes, and Grigori chooses not to fight them.
events.quote: Two head straight for him, each stopping before the bowls.

events.summary: Adeline kills a vampire and Chandra burns his body; the two share a moment of respite.
events.quote: As she drives her sword through the vampire's heart

events.summary: The group finishes its fifth counterattack of the week at a village, where Arlinn cares for a boy who ran to them.
events.quote: This is the fifth counterattack they've launched this week.

events.summary: Arlinn tells the group they cannot keep fighting like this, and Teferi says he cannot hold the moon in place with Innistrad's ancient magic.
events.quote: "There's no song and dance about it," she says. "We can't keep this up."

events.summary: Arlinn argues that the endless night will starve the vampires too and proposes visiting Sorin Markov.
events.quote: "The endless night doesn't just affect humans."

events.summary: Adeline agrees to go to Sorin, hoping a trace of Avacyn remains in him, and comforts the boy from Karo.
events.quote: "I'll go. If there's a trace of Avacyn left in him, he'll listen."

events.summary: In a flashback to six millennia earlier, Sorin tells his grandfather Edgar that vampires will drink Innistrad dry and Edgar dismisses it.
events.quote: "Sorin. Do you truly believe I've never had the same thought?"

events.summary: Sorin recalls that after six millennia he gave humans a protector, saving Innistrad, and reflects that defeat found him.
events.quote: Humans needed a protector. He gave them one.

events.summary: Sorin goes into the family archives to wake his grandfather Edgar and ask for a plan.
events.quote: His grandfather had been slumbering for long enough.

events.summary: Sorin discovers that Edgar's mausoleum and coffin have been stolen.
Sorin crushes a bat carrying an envelope addressed to him and recognizes the handwriting.
events.quote: He crushes it without a second thought.

events.summary: Sorin finds Arlinn and the others trespassing in his library.
events.quote: All in his library, in his family archives

events.summary: Sorin reveals the invitation to Olivia Voldaren's wedding and that she has stolen Edgar; if they marry she will rule all of Innistrad.
Arlinn reads the invitation and declares the group will crash the wedding.
events.quote: "Looks like we've got a wedding to crash."

relations.note: Grandson and grandfather; Edgar turned Sorin.
relations.quote: not long after his grandfather turned him
To a wedding. Oliva Voldaren's wedding.
it was Olivia Voldaren who stole the Moonsilver Key

relations.note: They comfort each other after a fight.
Their fight has worn on her.
relations.quote: that, and whatever drove her fight with Tovolar

relations.note: Their short war ruined much of the manor.
relations.quote: His short war with Nahiri, his failed protege, left much of the place in ruins

relations.note: Teferi has known him for centuries and thinks he can get through to him.
relations.quote: "As someone who's known him for centuries, I think we can get through to him.

relations.note: The manor is Sorin's home on Innistrad.
relations.quote: Sorin descends the steps of Markov Manor.
